description: This file contains unit tests for the RialtoLogging module, using Google Test framework. It tests logging behavior, handler setup, and log level filtering for different components.

classes.name: RialtoLoggingTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing the RialtoLogging module, including setup, teardown, and log call verification.

methods.name: TestLogHandler
methods.description: A static method that increments the global handler call count, used as a mock log handler.

methods.name: EmptyLogHandler
methods.description: A static method that does nothing, used to reset log handlers.

methods.name: TestExpectLogCalls
methods.description: A method that triggers various log levels and verifies if the handler was called based on the current log level configuration.
